Thank you all for your ongoing love and support!
Cluckmech Oasis v1.3.15 is now available! Meet our new friends and check it out!~

Discounts & New Friends
Cluckmech Oasis joined the Steam Spring Sale on March 14 with an historically Low of -25%!

 New Mutation Store with fresh mutations!

The new big version [Abandoned Lab]. is officially coming -

“Recently, some strange cluckmechs have appeared in animal shop, quickly attracting the Animal Expedition ......
Meanwhile, Animal Crusaders whose attack in volcano was blocked, found some strange tracks while looking for a breakthrough.Two sides converge the clues, and the routes turn out to be strikingly similar!

As they follow the trail, the animals realize that the root of it all seems to point somewhere ......”


In the new version V1.2.0 "Abandoned Lab," players can experience the following content:

 Brand new scene: [Abandoned Lab], offering richer adventures and exploration areas
 6 new enemies + the Lab Boss, introducing the "shut down" mechanic for a more thrilling defense experience
 Now supportscontrollers&SteamDeck！Enjoy a more flexible gaming experienc!

Thanks to your continued support!

Brand new scene--[Abandoned Lab]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742106/045a489249ecb739a4688f4b6e633ef70efaf0f1.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742106/5bab0793d3aa8cd3b39999873fb749a24cfc1059.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742106/1c073bad1f43f689f1d3fbf3e30c8cecc29aac8c.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742106/e27a06e241cd40110253e4c0b9d62959d8dcb729.png
